title: Going to continue work, was hoping I even retweeted someone I respect who had something to teach. I did not. #100daychallenge fails, but I am learning
summary: Going to continue work, was hoping I even retweeted someone I respect who had something to teach. I did not. #100daychallenge fails, but I am learning about so many new perspectives and voices I will keep going. Did write 100 poems in 30 days
